description: Dark hero (Conquest 'monster'): the SHIPPED, artist-approved palette carried over unchanged (source: monster_rigged.blend materials summoner_body / summoner_roots / summoner_flame / summoner_mouth, linear Principled values converted to sRGB). Void-black body and crown, scorched maroon roots (the skirt), ember-tipped spikes, and the red maw - now painted where the lore puts the mouth: the gap framed by the chest's lower points and the skirt's peaks.
